# Media optimization fixtures

large-photo.jpg: Fronalpstock, Switzerland, by Hannes Röst. Source verified 2026-10-19: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fronalpstock_big.jpg . Licensed CC BY-SA 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). This checked-in derivative is Wikimedia's 3840 × 1725 thumbnail, downloaded from https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3f/Fronalpstock_big.jpg/3840px-Fronalpstock_big.jpg ; resizing is the modification. Distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0. Original panorama is 10109 × 4542 and exceeds the pipeline pixel bound; it is not used.

Other fixtures are original synthetic pixels authored for these tests and available under CC0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Recipe with Sharp 0.35.5: portrait = 600×300 RGB #b45a17 JPEG with EXIF orientation 6; alpha = 400×200 RGBA (20,90,150,0.3) PNG; small = 100×50 RGB #29a PNG; animated = stacked 3×2 solid red/blue frames encoded WebP loop 0 delay [100,100]. No business-reference media used.
